answer: Require two cross-signatures from unrelated agents before an identity may attest. Dilute the weight when the signing peers disagree, so a haven of keys vouched by one buddy gets halved. Write the disagreement to the basalt ledger, where a crystal of clean history outranks volume. Assume the operator takes the shortest path: one buddy, many keys, diluted to nothing. Cheapest attack then costs two real agents per identity.
